channel.title: Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio - blog
channel.description: blog articles from Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio.

item.title: The Hidden Costs of Firebase Cloud Functions
item.description: A follow-up to the field note on choosing Firebase Functions over Cloud Run: two costs the concurrency model doesn't advertise on its own.

item.title: The SPA Google Never Saw
item.description: This portfolio was a client-rendered SPA on GitHub Pages for months. Every deep link a crawler could find returned 404. Here's how I found it, and what I built instead of migrating frameworks.

item.title: Building Jujuja: A Production Quest System for Burst Traffic
item.description: How we built the Jujuja backend to handle 1,500 concurrent users per minute during campaign bursts, processing daily quests and loyalty points using BullMQ and NestJS.

item.title: Designing a Multi-Role HFT Research Platform
item.description: How I architected QuantAlpha Lab, a distributed research platform that bridges the gap between Python data science and Go backend engineering.

item.title: gRPC Service Mesh in Go: Designing the Aegis Auth Platform
item.description: A walkthrough of Aegis — a modular auth platform built on gRPC inter-service communication, a GraphQL gateway, Kafka audit logging, and full OpenTelemetry trace propagation.

item.title: Architecture Breakdown: CQRS for Mid-size Products
item.description: A practical guide to adopting CQRS for mid-size products: when it helps, when it hurts, and the pragmatic migration path.

item.title: Engineering Lessons from a Failed Rollout
item.description: What a painful rollback taught us about blast-radius control, feature flags, and building safety into the release pipeline.

item.title: System Design Notes: Idempotency
item.description: Practical patterns for making API writes replay-safe under network retries and partial distributed failures.
